brief.t: START HERE: Call Aaron and Evelyn, with Sam looped in, to reconcile both Silk Factor lots against the newly signed waiver and actual shipments.

ACT NOW 1: Silk Factor: client signature obtained; QA and traceability still open. Discrepancy 8 days old. New completed waiver visibly includes Luke’s client signature for both lots, superseding the missing-acceptance claim. Microbial results, conflicting dates, batch-record gaps and 61-unit/37-order shipment linkage remain unverified. Send internally: Aaron, Evelyn and Ron, reconcile both lots, actual shipments, microbial results and batch records against Luke’s signed waiver with Sam today, then document authorized disposition before further fulfillment.

ACT NOW 2: Morning Glory: formulation-safety decision still needed. Concern raised 4 days ago. Evelyn’s above-recommended-use report has no verified safety disposition; stronger-cooling feedback does not authorize an increase. Send internally: Ron, Aaron and Evelyn, reconcile the controlled formula and supplier safe-use documentation with Sam today, then record approved limits before another sample, increase or lot change.

ACT NOW 3: Hunter November 24 audit: controlled documents and realistic readiness. Audit is 3 days away. First status was due yesterday at 4 PM; completion is unverified. Fresh CRM says machinery is not operational and installation starts November 23; no Tuesday validation or weekend staffing is assumed. November 25 document dates need transparent reconciliation. Send internally: Ron and Evelyn, I’ll post the actual approved masters, evidence locations, missing resources and realistic dates on master 1138 today; reconcile November 25 document dates without backdating and keep installation, cleaning verification, training and product release gated.

next: Recommendation: Close Silk’s physical disposition first, then the formula-safety decision and an evidence-backed audit status. Do not promise operational machinery by Tuesday.

Scheduled: 2 tentative calendar events within 72 hours; nearest Monday November 23 at 9:30 AM Eastern. Fresh My Tasks: 14 active, 8 dated overdue, none due today, 4 future and 2 undated. Nearest task due November 23.
Noise: 34 messages suppressed from 54 new inbound.
Hunter audit readiness displaces Lice Sisters water because the November 24 deadline is now explicit; the 220-versus-217 kg water dependency remains open, not cleared.

CRM authenticated as Aidan; Purchasing 39 Needed / 17 open orders / 0 in QC / 54 Raw Materials. Starwest now recorded In Raw Materials, not independently verified physical QA/allocation. WhatsApp still signed out; older unread email capped and partial. No supplier/customer sends, spending, payments or operational record edits. Both substantive team reviews returned; Purchasing assessed four supplied originals plus attributed owner findings. Email independently reviewed Outlook; 15 full supplier draft readbacks and 39 inventory entries transported, other 24 full bodies not transported; rendering untested. Review is not operational clearance.
signal: Protect controlled product release, safe formulation and production continuity. No shipment or release promises without proof.
